title: lathyrus formosus
intro: Lathyrus formosus, commonly known as the Formosa pea or Formosa sweet pea, is a flowering plant species in the pea family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus formosus are attributed to its ability to act as an anticoagulant, vasodilator, and antioxidant, making it useful in treating various ailments such as high blood pressure and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus formosus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
